exposure: Management strategies (e.g., ventilatory modes, supportive therapies like vasopressors, inotropic agents, inhaled nitric oxide, Ilomedin, ECMO, surgical repair)
cohort: The study included 74 neonates with Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH) admitted to a central children's hospital in Vietnam between November 2021 and September 2023.
finding: This study observed a high hospital mortality rate of 50.0% and identified higher peak Vasoactive Inotropic Score (VIS) and elevated admission pulmonary artery systolic pressure (PASP) as independent predictors of hospital mortality in CDH neonates.
